title: Edison And Now We Breathe

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Ya son of a bitch ya did it. You actually did it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ya son of a bitch ya did it. You actually did it!

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I can't believe you found a way out of this mess. Read this article. You gotta read it! You fucking did it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't believe you found a way out of this mess. Read this article. You gotta read it! You fucking did it!

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: You don't know?! She already did. Haley's at home already. Safe and healthy. She doesn't even know she was in danger. Freya was good as her word... in the end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't know?! She already did. Haley's at home already. Safe and healthy. She doesn't even know she was in danger. Freya was good as her word... in the end.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Listen, I know what you did for me. I know the risks you took, the lines you crossed... I won't ever forget this. I promise.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, I know what you did for me. I know the risks you took, the lines you crossed... I won't ever forget this. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Hey, call me "Ed." My new name. That old name doesn't fit me no more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, call me "Ed." My new name. That old name doesn't fit me no more.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What now?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I still have two fake IDs left from Cirian's last batch. Haley and I will vanish. We can start over. I won't help The Network again, but I still want to find a way to help kids. Kids like Haley.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still have two fake IDs left from Cirian's last batch. Haley and I will vanish. We can start over. I won't help The Network again, but I still want to find a way to help kids. Kids like Haley.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds like a good plan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds like a good plan.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That sounds like a good plan.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That sounds like a good plan.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about me?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I've got a few strings left I can pull. I'll be watching out for you. From a distance sure... but I'll still be there. I'll spend the rest of my life trying to think of ways to help you out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've got a few strings left I can pull. I'll be watching out for you. From a distance sure... but I'll still be there. I'll spend the rest of my life trying to think of ways to help you out.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Goodbye friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But will Freya hold up her end of the bargain..?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But will Freya hold up her end of the bargain..?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But will Freya hold up her end of the bargain..?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But will Freya hold up her end of the bargain..?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You got nerve showing up here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got nerve showing up here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You got nerve showing up here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You got nerve showing up here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where have you been?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where have you been?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It all worked out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It all worked out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll hold you to that Edison.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll hold you to that Edison.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll hold you to that Edison.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll hold you to that Edison.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I had to kill someone for Haley to be free...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I had to kill someone for Haley to be free...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I had to kill someone for Haley to be free...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I had to kill someone for Haley to be free...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: WE did it buddy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: WE did it buddy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When you play business in Nivalis, you play for blood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When you play business in Nivalis, you play for blood.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: When you play business in Nivalis, you play for blood.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: When you play business in Nivalis, you play for blood.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just look after your niece Edison.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just look after your niece Edison.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just look after your niece Edison.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just look after your niece Edison.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Goodbye Ed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye Ed.
